title: Burnings of trees and their homologies
summary: The problem of graph burning was firstly introduced as a model for different processes of social and network interactions. Recently, the authors of the present paper developed methods of algebraic topology for investigation of this problem. This approach is based on the new definition of burning process which excludes the possibility to choose at any moment vertex for burning from the set of vertices which are already burned at this moment.
